notes: Gutter-strip intersections near the right edge (should also be on 22-26R): ?/W. 8th corner (5773,372), State/W. 8th (6040,368), State/Pardee (5995,663), State/Hatmaker (5970,910), State/Staebler (5928,1252), State/Storrs (5880,1572), State/St. Michael (5812,2017), State/English (5803,2416), Warsaw/? (5740,2335), State/W. 6th (6090,3030); if 22-26R reaches that far west also Maryland/Elberon junction (5575,2905) and ?/W. 6th (5627,3655). State Avenue is a ~75 px corridor with rail tracks; its points are ~15 px. Neave Street's centreline lies just beyond this half's right edge (block edge at x~6157), so Neave junctions are left to 22-26R. The unnamed diagonal (printed '...W. AVE', with 'PRI' in it; not resolved) runs from the Elberon/Maryland junction NNE; Warsaw ends on it at (5740,2335) and it then merges into State at a shallow angle around y 2200-2300 (no well-defined centreline crossing, so no State/? point recorded). The road south from the Elberon/Maryland junction to W. 6th has no legible name (1904 sheet 458: Price Hill Rd). No bracketed old names seen. Inferred names (flag): the leg SE of Elberon printed only 'AVE.' is taken as Ansonia (continues straight across Elberon); the NE leg across Mt. Hope Road printed only 'AVE.' is taken as Galvin (addresses run on from 2501-2512 to 2488-2462); 'WAY' (just south of Bassett) and 'ALPINE' (further south) are on one street, recorded as Alpine Way. Goodhue is printed without a suffix. Mt. Hope Road continues south of y~2990 on the same line as Filson Terrace (name change, no crossing; the west edge jogs there), Taylor Avenue becomes Goodhue at y~2990 the same way, and Gabriel becomes Center at the pipe line y~5735. W. 8th is in two pieces (Elberon-Matson, and from the corner road at x~5773 east to State). Warsaw and Maryland enter from the top edge and run parallel with no crossing until the convergence. W. 6th runs along the NW side of the railroad; its points are placed ~25 px SE of the lot frontage (SE edge not clearly drawn), ~15 px. Everything SE of the heavy double boundary line (from ~(3200,7700) NE to ~(5850,4350), then east along y~4450) is an inset of another district (St. Joseph Cemetery, Cathedral Catholic Cemetery, Foley, Nebraska Ave., Amelia); not picked. 'LAURA', 'FULLER & CO.' and 'TAYLOR' near the terraces are owner names, not streets.
